ex.en: Uninstall the app if you don't use it anymore.
ex.zh: 如果不再使用這個 App，就把它解除安裝。

ex.en: I uninstalled the game to free up space.
ex.zh: 我刪掉遊戲來騰出空間。

ex.en: Translate the underlined part.
ex.zh: 翻譯畫線的部分。

ex.en: Correct the underlined words.
ex.zh: 請改正畫線的字詞。

ex.en: The accident underlines the need for better training.
ex.zh: 這起事故凸顯了加強訓練的必要。

ex.en: The report underlines the importance of customer service.
ex.zh: 這份報告強調了客戶服務的重要性。

ex.en: My life seems unreal.
ex.zh: 我的生活感覺好不真實。

ex.en: Winning the award felt completely unreal.
ex.zh: 得獎的感覺完全不真實。

ex.en: The view from the top was unreal.
ex.zh: 從山頂看出去的景色美得不可思議。

ex.en: The prices in this city are unreal.
ex.zh: 這個城市的物價誇張到難以置信。

ex.en: Even with all his wealth and fame, he's unhappy.
ex.zh: 雖然有錢又有名，他還是不快樂。

ex.en: Tom said he thought Mary was unhappy in Boston.
ex.zh: 湯姆說他覺得瑪麗在波士頓過得不快樂。

ex.en: I don't think Tom knows that Mary is unhappy.
ex.zh: 我想湯姆不知道瑪麗不開心。

ex.en: Tom was unhappy because she wouldn't ask him anything.
ex.zh: 湯姆很不高興，因為她什麼都不問他。

ex.en: Many customers are unhappy with the new service.
ex.zh: 很多顧客對新服務不滿意。

ex.en: Do not leave your bags unattended.
ex.zh: 請勿將行李放置無人看管。

ex.en: Never leave children unattended in a car.
ex.zh: 絕對不要把小孩單獨留在車上。

ex.en: The landscape is unfamiliar to me.
ex.zh: 這片風景對我來說很陌生。

ex.en: The word is unfamiliar to me.
ex.zh: 我不熟悉這個字。

ex.en: The cat was scared by an unfamiliar noise.
ex.zh: 貓被一個陌生的聲音嚇到了。

ex.en: This plan includes unlimited mobile data.
ex.zh: 這個方案包含無限上網。

ex.en: Employees get unlimited access to the gym.
ex.zh: 員工可以無限次使用健身房。

ex.en: We don't have an unlimited budget.
ex.zh: 我們的預算不是無限的。

ex.en: He was unsure how he would get there, and when.
ex.zh: 他不確定要怎麼去那裡、什麼時候去。

ex.en: She seemed somewhat unsure of herself.
ex.zh: 她似乎有點沒自信。

ex.en: If you're unsure, ask your manager.
ex.zh: 如果你不確定，就問你的主管。

ex.en: Careful as he was, he made an unexpected mistake.
ex.zh: 他雖然很小心，還是犯了個意想不到的錯誤。

ex.en: That is rather unexpected.
ex.zh: 這真的很出乎意料。

ex.en: A slip of the tongue often brings about unexpected results.
ex.zh: 一時失言常常會帶來意想不到的後果。

unspecified.zh: 未指明的、未具體說明的

ex.en: The meeting was delayed for an unspecified reason.
ex.zh: 會議因不明原因延後了。

ex.en: He was paid an unspecified amount.
ex.zh: 他拿到一筆未公開金額的款項。

ex.en: The facts proved that our worries were unnecessary.
ex.zh: 事實證明我們的擔心是多餘的。

ex.en: I believe this was unnecessary.
ex.zh: 我認為這是不必要的。

ex.en: Let's avoid unnecessary expenses this month.
ex.zh: 這個月我們要避免不必要的開銷。

unavailable.zh: 無法取得的、無法使用的

ex.en: We're sorry. The number you have dialed is currently unavailable.
ex.zh: 很抱歉，您撥的電話目前無法接通。

ex.en: This product is currently unavailable.
ex.zh: 這項商品目前缺貨。

ex.en: The manager is unavailable today.
ex.zh: 經理今天沒空。

ex.en: I'll be unavailable until Monday.
ex.zh: 我到星期一之前都無法聯絡。

ex.en: I felt cold and uncomfortable the entire night.
ex.zh: 我整晚都覺得又冷又不舒服。

ex.en: These shoes are uncomfortable to walk in.
ex.zh: 這雙鞋穿起來走路不舒服。

ex.en: Stop it! You're making her feel uncomfortable!
ex.zh: 住手！你讓她覺得不自在了！

ex.en: I didn’t mean to make anyone uncomfortable.
ex.zh: 我不是故意要讓任何人不自在。

ex.en: The weather is unusually cold.
ex.zh: 天氣異常寒冷。

ex.en: The office was unusually quiet today.
ex.zh: 今天辦公室格外安靜。

ex.en: Sales were unusually high this month.
ex.zh: 這個月的業績異常地高。

ex.en: Unused tickets can be refunded.
ex.zh: 未使用的票可以退款。

ex.en: There are some unused rooms upstairs.
ex.zh: 樓上有幾間閒置的房間。

ex.en: Construction of the new station is already underway.
ex.zh: 新車站的工程已經在進行中。

ex.en: Preparations for the conference are well underway.
ex.zh: 會議的籌備工作已順利展開。

unpleasant.zh: 令人不愉快的、討厭的；不客氣的

ex.en: The gas gives off a strong, unpleasant smell.
ex.zh: 這種氣體會散發強烈難聞的氣味。

ex.en: We had an unpleasant experience there.
ex.zh: 我們在那裡有過一段不愉快的經驗。

ex.en: He was very unpleasant to the waiter.
ex.zh: 他對服務生很不客氣。

ex.en: The hotel has an underground parking garage.
ex.zh: 這家飯店有地下停車場。

ex.en: There is an underground passage to the station.
ex.zh: 有一條地下道通往車站。

ex.en: Let's take the underground.
ex.zh: 我們搭地鐵去吧。

ex.en: Get on the underground here.
ex.zh: 在這裡搭地鐵。

ex.en: The London Underground is very busy at rush hour.
ex.zh: 倫敦地鐵在尖峰時段非常擁擠。

ex.en: The cables run underground.
ex.zh: 電纜埋在地下。

ex.en: Many animals live underground.
ex.zh: 許多動物生活在地底下。

ex.en: The invoice is still unpaid.
ex.zh: 這張發票還沒付款。

ex.en: You have an unpaid balance of 500 dollars.
ex.zh: 你還有 500 元的未付餘額。

ex.en: She took two weeks of unpaid leave.
ex.zh: 她請了兩週的無薪假。

ex.en: Many interns do unpaid work.
ex.zh: 許多實習生做的是無薪工作。

ex.en: I hear that the number of the unemployed has been increasing recently.
ex.zh: 聽說最近失業人數一直在增加。

ex.en: He has been unemployed for six months.
ex.zh: 他已經失業六個月了。

ex.en: The program helps unemployed workers find new jobs.
ex.zh: 這個計畫幫助失業勞工找到新工作。

ex.en: They are unreliable.
ex.zh: 他們靠不住。

ex.en: The bus service here is unreliable.
ex.zh: 這裡的公車服務不太可靠。

ex.en: That website is an unreliable source of information.
ex.zh: 那個網站的資訊來源不可靠。

unauthorized.zh: 未經授權的、未經許可的

ex.en: Unauthorized access to this area is prohibited.
ex.zh: 未經授權不得進入此區域。

ex.en: The bank noticed an unauthorized transaction on my card.
ex.zh: 銀行發現我的卡有一筆未經授權的交易。

ex.en: Unplug all the cables.
ex.zh: 把所有的線都拔掉。

ex.en: Unplug the printer before you clean it.
ex.zh: 清潔印表機前，先拔掉插頭。

ex.en: Constant criticism can undermine your confidence.
ex.zh: 不斷的批評會削弱你的自信。

ex.en: The scandal undermined public trust in the company.
ex.zh: 這起醜聞削弱了大眾對公司的信任。

ex.en: Whether the medicine will work or not is uncertain.
ex.zh: 這種藥是否有效還不確定。

ex.en: The future is very uncertain.
ex.zh: 未來充滿不確定性。

ex.en: I was uncertain whether to advance or to retreat.
ex.zh: 我拿不定主意該前進還是後退。

ex.en: Tom is still uncertain about whether to go to college or not.
ex.zh: 湯姆還拿不定主意要不要上大學。

ex.en: You should've rejected such an unfair proposal.
ex.zh: 你當初應該拒絕那麼不公平的提議。

ex.en: That was really unfair.
ex.zh: 那真的很不公平。

ex.en: It is unfair.
ex.zh: 這不公平。

ex.en: The insurance company refused to underwrite the policy.
ex.zh: 保險公司拒絕承保這張保單。

ex.en: Which company underwrites your car insurance?
ex.zh: 你的車險是哪家公司承保的？

ex.en: Two banks will underwrite the share issue.
ex.zh: 兩家銀行將承銷這次股票發行。

ex.en: The bank underwrote the company's bonds.
ex.zh: 這家銀行承銷了該公司的債券。

ex.en: Interest rates remained unchanged.
ex.zh: 利率維持不變。

ex.en: The price has been unchanged for years.
ex.zh: 價格好幾年都沒變。

ex.en: Microsoft recently unveiled two new dual screen devices.
ex.zh: 微軟最近推出了兩款雙螢幕裝置。

ex.en: Apple unveiled a new iPhone.
ex.zh: 蘋果推出了新款 iPhone。

ex.en: NASA has recently unveiled a new project.
ex.zh: NASA 最近公布了一項新計畫。

ex.en: The king’s portrait was unveiled to great applause.
ex.zh: 國王的肖像揭幕時，獲得熱烈掌聲。

ex.en: The mayor unveiled a statue in the park.
ex.zh: 市長在公園為一座雕像揭幕。

ex.en: Unity, justice and freedom are the pledge of fortune.
ex.zh: 團結、公正與自由是幸福的保證。

ex.en: The team showed great unity.
ex.zh: 這支團隊展現了高度的團結。

ex.en: The CEO called for unity after the merger.
ex.zh: 合併後，執行長呼籲大家團結。

unpopular.zh: 不受歡迎的、不得人心的

ex.en: The new policy is unpopular with employees.
ex.zh: 新政策不受員工歡迎。

ex.en: It was an unpopular decision, but it was necessary.
ex.zh: 這個決定不得人心，但卻是必要的。

ex.en: The company saw unprecedented growth last year.
ex.zh: 公司去年經歷了前所未有的成長。

ex.en: We are facing an unprecedented challenge.
ex.zh: 我們正面臨空前的挑戰。

ex.en: I dare not probe too deeply, lest I uncover the awful truth!
ex.zh: 我不敢探究得太深，以免揭開可怕的真相！

ex.en: The audit uncovered several errors in the accounts.
ex.zh: 稽核發現帳目中有幾處錯誤。

ex.en: Reporters uncovered evidence of fraud.
ex.zh: 記者揭露了詐欺的證據。

ex.en: Don't underestimate your own strength.
ex.zh: 不要低估自己的實力。

ex.en: That is not to be underestimated.
ex.zh: 這一點不容小覷。

ex.en: We underestimated the cost of the project.
ex.zh: 我們低估了這個專案的成本。

underwriter.zh: 保險業者、核保人；（證券）承銷商

ex.en: The underwriter rejected the insurance application.
ex.zh: 核保人員拒絕了這份投保申請。

ex.en: The bank acted as the underwriter for the IPO.
ex.zh: 這家銀行擔任首次公開發行的承銷商。

unpredictable.zh: 無法預測的、難以捉摸的

ex.en: This week the weather was very unpredictable.
ex.zh: 這週的天氣變化莫測。

ex.en: The stock market can be very unpredictable.
ex.zh: 股市有時非常難以預測。

ex.en: Many companies undervalue their employees.
ex.zh: 許多公司低估了員工的價值。

ex.en: Some analysts think the stock is undervalued.
ex.zh: 有些分析師認為這檔股票被低估了。

ex.en: The computer is undoubtedly a valuable tool.
ex.zh: 電腦無疑是很有用的工具。

ex.en: All these new blocks will undoubtedly impact the loading speed of the home page.
ex.zh: 這些新的區塊無疑會影響首頁的載入速度。

ex.en: He was unwilling to admit his mistake.
ex.zh: 他不願意承認自己的錯誤。

ex.en: Many companies are unwilling to take risks.
ex.zh: 許多公司不願意冒險。

ex.en: The weather conditions were unfavorable for the flight.
ex.zh: 天候狀況不利於飛行。

ex.en: The exchange rate is unfavorable right now.
ex.zh: 目前的匯率不太有利。

ex.en: The movie received unfavorable reviews.
ex.zh: 這部電影得到負面評價。

ex.en: The survey showed an unfavorable view of the new policy.
ex.zh: 調查顯示大家對新政策觀感不佳。

ex.en: The two incidents are completely unrelated.
ex.zh: 這兩起事件完全無關。

ex.en: Please don't ask questions unrelated to today's topic.
ex.zh: 請不要問和今天主題無關的問題。

ex.en: Although they share a last name, they're unrelated.
ex.zh: 雖然他們同姓，但沒有親戚關係。

ex.en: Tom and Amy look alike, but they're unrelated.
ex.zh: 湯姆和艾咪長得很像，但他們沒有血緣關係。

ex.en: He tried to unify the various groups.
ex.zh: 他試著把各個團體團結起來。

ex.en: The new system unifies all our customer data.
ex.zh: 新系統整合了我們所有的客戶資料。

ex.en: The coach worked hard to unify the team.
ex.zh: 教練努力讓全隊團結一致。

ex.en: An unsecured loan usually has a higher interest rate.
ex.zh: 無擔保貸款的利率通常比較高。

ex.en: Credit card debt is a type of unsecured debt.
ex.zh: 信用卡債務是一種無擔保債務。

unsecured.zh: （網路、系統）未加密的、未受保護的

ex.en: Avoid using unsecured Wi-Fi in public places.
ex.zh: 在公共場所避免使用沒有加密的 Wi-Fi。

ex.en: Hackers found an unsecured server with customer data.
ex.zh: 駭客發現一台存有客戶資料、未受保護的伺服器。

ex.en: We unexpectedly found a cat in the box.
ex.zh: 我們意外地在箱子裡發現了一隻貓。

ex.en: Prices rose unexpectedly last month.
ex.zh: 上個月物價意外上漲。

ex.en: My manager called unexpectedly on Sunday.
ex.zh: 我的主管星期天突然打電話來。

ex.en: Strong data underpins our recommendations.
ex.zh: 我們的建議以扎實的數據為基礎。

ex.en: Trust underpins every good business relationship.
ex.zh: 信任是所有良好商業關係的基礎。

ex.en: The cat is under the table.
ex.zh: 貓在桌子底下。

ex.en: I found my keys under the sofa.
ex.zh: 我在沙發底下找到鑰匙。

ex.en: There is no admission fee for children under five.
ex.zh: 五歲以下兒童免費入場。

ex.en: The price is under 500 dollars.
ex.zh: 價格不到五百元。

ex.en: They conducted a series of experiments under zero gravity.
ex.zh: 他們在無重力狀態下進行了一系列實驗。

ex.en: The road is under construction.
ex.zh: 這條路正在施工。

ex.en: You seem to be a little under the weather.
ex.zh: 你看起來好像有點不舒服。

ex.en: I'm feeling a bit under the weather.
ex.zh: 我覺得有點不舒服。

ex.en: Students generally like a teacher who understands their problems.
ex.zh: 學生通常喜歡能理解他們問題的老師。

ex.en: I don't think Tom understands what's going on.
ex.zh: 我覺得湯姆不了解現在發生了什麼事。

ex.en: Could she make herself understood in French in Paris?
ex.zh: 她在巴黎說法語，別人聽得懂嗎？

ex.en: I understand that you're leaving the company.
ex.zh: 我聽說你要離開公司了。

ex.en: As I understand it, the meeting has been moved.
ex.zh: 據我所知，會議時間已經改了。

ex.en: Phrases are syntactical units.
ex.zh: 片語是句法單位。

ex.en: The family is the fundamental unit of society.
ex.zh: 家庭是社會的基本單位。

ex.en: The meter is a unit of length.
ex.zh: 公尺是長度單位。

ex.en: We sold 5,000 units last month.
ex.zh: 我們上個月賣出五千台。

ex.en: The unit price is ten dollars.
ex.zh: 單價是十元。

ex.en: Please read Unit 5 before class.
ex.zh: 上課前請讀第五單元。

ex.en: This unit covers basic grammar.
ex.zh: 這個單元涵蓋基礎文法。

ex.en: The instructions are unclear to me.
ex.zh: 這些說明我看不太懂。

ex.en: It is still unclear when the store will reopen.
ex.zh: 目前仍不清楚這家店何時會重新營業。

ex.en: If anything is unclear, please let me know.
ex.zh: 如果有任何不清楚的地方，請告訴我。

ex.en: My first day in the university was rather boring.
ex.zh: 我上大學的第一天相當無聊。

ex.en: Universities have classrooms and dormitories.
ex.zh: 大學裡有教室，也有宿舍。

ex.en: Kyoto has many universities.
ex.zh: 京都有很多所大學。

ex.en: Unfortunately, the telephone was out of order.
ex.zh: 不巧的是，電話壞了。

ex.en: Unfortunately I will not have much free time.
ex.zh: 可惜我不會有太多空閒時間。

ex.en: Unfortunately I was not in time for his speech.
ex.zh: 很可惜，我沒趕上他的演講。

ex.en: Did the union participate in the demonstration?
ex.zh: 工會有參加示威遊行嗎？

ex.en: The union and the company have agreed upon a new contract.
ex.zh: 工會和公司已就新合約達成協議。

ex.en: Albania wants to join the European Union.
ex.zh: 阿爾巴尼亞想加入歐盟。

ex.en: The Cold War ended when the Soviet Union collapsed.
ex.zh: 冷戰隨著蘇聯解體而結束。

ex.en: These flowers have a unique smell.
ex.zh: 這些花有一種獨特的香味。

ex.en: Each and every person is unique.
ex.zh: 每個人都是獨一無二的。

ex.en: Each product has a unique serial number.
ex.zh: 每項產品都有獨一無二的序號。

ex.en: We are sorry we are unable to accept your request.
ex.zh: 很抱歉，我們無法接受你的要求。

ex.en: I was unable to go to his birthday party.
ex.zh: 我當時沒辦法去他的生日派對。

ex.en: Many people are unable to comprehend the actions of hackers.
ex.zh: 很多人無法理解駭客的行為。

ex.en: It's unlike him to get so angry.
ex.zh: 他這麼生氣，真不像他。

ex.en: Jennifer lives a peaceful life in the small village, unlike us with our busy city lives.
ex.zh: 珍妮佛在小村莊過著平靜的生活，不像我們在城市裡忙碌地過日子。

ex.en: Unlike his brother, Tom loves sports.
ex.zh: 和他哥哥不同，湯姆很愛運動。

ex.en: The two brothers are quite unlike in their appearance.
ex.zh: 那兩兄弟長得一點也不像。

ex.en: The twins are completely unlike in personality.
ex.zh: 這對雙胞胎的個性完全不同。

unusual.zh: 不尋常的、罕見的、特別的

ex.en: The weather has been unusual this year.
ex.zh: 今年的天氣很反常。

ex.en: Did you hear anything unusual lately?
ex.zh: 你最近有聽到什麼不尋常的事嗎？

ex.en: The house stood out because of its unusual shape.
ex.zh: 那棟房子因為造型特殊而格外顯眼。

ex.en: He is too young to undertake this work.
ex.zh: 他太年輕，無法承擔這項工作。

ex.en: The company will undertake a major review of its policies.
ex.zh: 公司將全面檢討其政策。

ex.en: We undertook the project with a small budget.
ex.zh: 我們以很少的預算接下了這個專案。

ex.en: He undertook to finish the report by Friday.
ex.zh: 他答應在星期五前完成報告。

ex.en: The supplier undertook to deliver the goods on time.
ex.zh: 供應商保證會準時交貨。

ex.en: I think it's unlikely that Tom will get elected.
ex.zh: 我覺得湯姆不太可能當選。

ex.en: It's unlikely that he did anything wrong.
ex.zh: 他不太可能做錯什麼事。

ex.en: I know that it is highly unlikely that anyone knows me.
ex.zh: 我知道幾乎不可能有人認識我。

ex.en: The cause of the fire was unknown.
ex.zh: 火災原因不明。

ex.en: The suspect's gender is currently unknown.
ex.zh: 嫌犯的性別目前不明。

ex.en: Tom is an unknown artist.
ex.zh: 湯姆是個沒沒無聞的藝術家。

ex.en: The film stars an unknown actor.
ex.zh: 這部電影由一位沒沒無聞的演員主演。

ex.en: Fear comes from the unknown.
ex.zh: 恐懼來自未知。

ex.en: Starting a business means facing the unknown.
ex.zh: 創業就是要面對未知。

ex.en: The girl in a white uniform took my temperature.
ex.zh: 一位穿白色制服的女生幫我量了體溫。

ex.en: Japanese companies generally provide their employees with uniforms.
ex.zh: 日本公司通常會提供員工制服。

ex.en: New York City policemen wear dark blue uniforms.
ex.zh: 紐約市的警察穿深藍色制服。

ex.en: All the rooms are a uniform size.
ex.zh: 所有房間的大小都一樣。

ex.en: We need a uniform standard for all branches.
ex.zh: 所有分店需要一套統一的標準。

underlie.zh: 構成⋯的基礎、是⋯的根本原因（常用 underlying：根本的、潛在的）

ex.en: The underlying causes of the problem are widely known.
ex.zh: 這個問題的根本原因眾所皆知。

ex.en: Several factors underlie the drop in sales.
ex.zh: 銷售下滑背後有幾個因素。

ex.en: We need to fix the underlying problem.
ex.zh: 我們需要解決根本的問題。

ex.en: There is no universal solution to this problem.
ex.zh: 這個問題沒有放諸四海皆準的解法。

ex.en: The plan received universal support from the staff.
ex.zh: 這項計畫得到全體員工的支持。

ex.en: English is a kind of universal language.
ex.zh: 英語是一種世界通用的語言。

ex.en: English is a universal language and is used all over the world.
ex.zh: 英語是通用語言，世界各地都在使用。

undergo.zh: 經歷、接受（手術、檢查、改變）

ex.en: Father is going to undergo an operation.
ex.zh: 爸爸即將接受手術。

ex.en: He underwent severe criticism.
ex.zh: 他遭受了嚴厲的批評。

ex.en: The company is undergoing major changes.
ex.zh: 公司正在經歷重大變革。

uncle.zh: 叔叔、伯伯、舅舅、姑丈、姨丈

ex.en: My uncle has a flower shop near the station.
ex.zh: 我叔叔在車站附近開了一家花店。

ex.en: My uncle has lived in Paris for ten years.
ex.zh: 我叔叔在巴黎住了十年。

ex.en: My uncles come to see me from time to time.
ex.zh: 我的叔叔們偶爾會來看我。

ex.en: Our world is only one small part of the universe.
ex.zh: 我們的世界只是宇宙的一小部分。

ex.en: How many galaxies are there in the universe?
ex.zh: 宇宙中有多少個星系？

ex.en: The age of the universe is about 13.75 billion years.
ex.zh: 宇宙的年齡大約是 137.5 億年。

ex.en: There is a lot of uncertainty about the economy.
ex.zh: 經濟前景有很多不確定性。

ex.en: The uncertainty made it hard to plan ahead.
ex.zh: 這種不確定性讓人很難事先規劃。

ex.en: Oceans do not so much divide the world as unite it.
ex.zh: 海洋與其說是分隔世界，不如說是把世界連在一起。

ex.en: The crisis united the whole team.
ex.zh: 這場危機讓全隊團結起來。

ex.en: We must unite to solve this problem.
ex.zh: 我們必須團結起來解決這個問題。

undergraduate.zh: 大學生（尚未畢業的學士生）

ex.en: The course is open to all undergraduates.
ex.zh: 這門課開放給所有大學部學生修。

ex.en: She was an undergraduate at National Taiwan University.
ex.zh: 她大學時就讀台大。

ex.en: He has an undergraduate degree in economics.
ex.zh: 他擁有經濟學學士學位。

ex.en: The university offers over fifty undergraduate programs.
ex.zh: 這所大學提供五十多個學士學程。

ex.en: I found the key underneath the mat.
ex.zh: 我在門口地墊下面找到了鑰匙。

ex.en: The cat is sleeping underneath the table.
ex.zh: 貓正在桌子底下睡覺。

ex.en: Please write your name underneath the photo.
ex.zh: 請在照片下方寫上你的名字。

ex.en: Underneath we wrote the names of the students in our class.
ex.zh: 我們在下面寫上班上同學的名字。

ex.en: He seems tough, but underneath he's very kind.
ex.zh: 他看起來很強硬，但其實內心很善良。

ex.en: The announcement at the station was almost unintelligible.
ex.zh: 車站的廣播幾乎聽不清楚在說什麼。

ex.en: His handwriting is completely unintelligible to me.
ex.zh: 他的字跡我完全看不懂。

ex.en: In consequence of some badly coded functions, the system is unstable most of the time.
ex.zh: 由於有些函式寫得很糟，系統大多時候都不穩定。

ex.en: People's emotional lives are becoming more and more unstable.
ex.zh: 人們的感情生活變得越來越不穩定。

ex.en: The internet connection here is very unstable.
ex.zh: 這裡的網路連線很不穩定。

ex.en: He enthusiastically engaged himself in this honorable undertaking.
ex.zh: 他熱忱地投身於這份光榮的事業。

ex.en: Opening a branch overseas is a major undertaking.
ex.zh: 在海外開設分公司是一項重大的任務。

ex.en: The supplier gave a written undertaking to deliver on time.
ex.zh: 供應商以書面承諾會準時交貨。

ex.en: You don't have to go unless you want to.
ex.zh: 除非你想去，否則不用去。

ex.en: We won't go out unless it stops raining.
ex.zh: 除非雨停了，不然我們不會出門。

ex.en: You'll never know unless you try.
ex.zh: 不試試看永遠不會知道。

ex.en: This is uniquely good.
ex.zh: 這真是好得獨一無二。

ex.en: She is uniquely qualified for this position.
ex.zh: 她具備擔任這個職位的獨特資格。

ex.en: The hotel offers a uniquely local experience.
ex.zh: 這家飯店提供獨特的在地體驗。

ex.en: Everyone loves it when the underdog wins.
ex.zh: 大家都喜歡看不被看好的一方獲勝。

ex.en: They were the underdogs, but they won the final.
ex.zh: 他們不被看好，卻贏了決賽。

undesirable.zh: 令人不快的、不受歡迎的

ex.en: The medicine has some undesirable side effects.
ex.zh: 這種藥有一些令人不快的副作用。

ex.en: The landlord refused to rent to undesirable tenants.
ex.zh: 房東拒絕把房子租給不受歡迎的房客。

ex.en: An unforgettable event occurred.
ex.zh: 一場令人難忘的事件發生了。

ex.en: It really is unforgettable for me! Thank you!
ex.zh: 真的令我難忘! 謝謝你!

ex.en: The trip to Japan was an unforgettable experience.
ex.zh: 日本之旅是一次難忘的經驗。

ex.en: Yesterday there was an unfortunate accident.
ex.zh: 昨天發生了一個不幸的事故。

ex.en: She is rich, but unfortunate.
ex.zh: 她很有錢卻很不幸。

ex.en: He is unfortunate.
ex.zh: 他命運多舛。

ex.en: It's ungrateful to complain after all the help you received.
ex.zh: 得到這麼多幫助之後還抱怨，就是忘恩負義。

ex.en: Her ungrateful son never called to say thank you.
ex.zh: 她那個忘恩負義的兒子從來沒打電話道謝。

understandable.zh: 可以理解的、情有可原的

ex.en: They spoke of their high exam grades with understandable pride.
ex.zh: 他們談到考試的好成績時很驕傲，這是可以理解的。

ex.en: It's understandable that you feel nervous on your first day.
ex.zh: 第一天上班會緊張是可以理解的。

ex.en: The rise in prices caused social unrest in the city.
ex.zh: 物價上漲在城市裡引發了社會動盪。

ex.en: Many tourists cancelled their trips because of the political unrest.
ex.zh: 由於政治動盪，許多遊客取消了旅行。

ex.en: What is the unemployment rate at the moment?
ex.zh: 目前的失業率是多少？

ex.en: In the discussion the accent was on unemployment.
ex.zh: 討論的重點放在失業問題。

ex.en: The best way to solve unemployment is to work.
ex.zh: 解決失業最好的辦法就是去工作。

ex.en: The workers unloaded the truck in an hour.
ex.zh: 工人一個小時就把卡車上的貨卸完了。

ex.en: Please help me unload the groceries from the car.
ex.zh: 請幫我把車上買的東西搬下來。

ex.en: The undersigned parties agree to these terms.
ex.zh: 下方簽署的各方同意這些條款。

ex.en: I, the undersigned, confirm that the details are accurate.
ex.zh: 本人，即下方簽署人，確認資料正確無誤。

ex.en: The board reached unanimity after the final cost estimate was approved.
ex.zh: 最後一份成本估算獲得核准後，董事會全體達成一致。

ex.en: There was unanimity among the reviewers that the safety issue needed immediate action.
ex.zh: 審查人員一致認為必須立即處理這項安全問題。

untapped.zh: 尚未開發的；未充分利用的

ex.en: The report identified untapped demand in rural areas.
ex.zh: 報告指出鄉村地區仍有尚未開發的需求。

ex.en: The company sees untapped potential in this market.
ex.zh: 公司看好這個市場尚未發揮的潛力。

ex.en: The unfurnished unit costs less but requires a larger deposit.
ex.zh: 這間未附家具的房子租金較低，但需要較高押金。

ex.en: The landlord offers both furnished and unfurnished apartments.
ex.zh: 房東同時出租附家具和未附家具的公寓。

ex.en: The store accepts returns of unopened products within thirty days.
ex.zh: 商店接受三十天內退回未拆封商品。

ex.en: Keep the bottle unopened until the technician arrives.
ex.zh: 請先不要打開瓶子，等技術人員到場。

ex.en: He listens to jazz to unwind after a demanding shift.
ex.zh: 忙碌值班後，他會聽爵士樂放鬆。

ex.en: Guests can unwind by the pool after the conference.
ex.zh: 會議結束後，賓客可以在泳池畔放鬆。

ex.en: Pedestrians can use the underpass to get to the other side.
ex.zh: 行人可以走地下道到另一邊。

ex.en: The underpass floods when it rains heavily.
ex.zh: 下大雨時地下道會淹水。

ex.en: He was found lying unconscious on the kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 他被人發現倒在廚房的地板上，不省人事。

ex.en: She was knocked unconscious by the fall.
ex.zh: 她摔倒後昏了過去。

ex.en: Biting her nails was an unconscious habit.
ex.zh: 咬指甲是她無意識的習慣。

ex.en: Many of our decisions are shaped by unconscious bias.
ex.zh: 我們很多決定都受到潛意識偏見的影響。

ex.en: The unit price drops if you order more than 100.
ex.zh: 訂購超過 100 件，單價會降低。

ex.en: Please list the unit price and total amount.
ex.zh: 請列出單價和總金額。

ex.en: The vote is unanimous.
ex.zh: 表決結果是全體一致通過。

ex.en: The committee reached a unanimous decision.
ex.zh: 委員會做出了一致的決定。
